title: Intimate relationship does not mean it was consensual if woman was deceived or blackmailed: Madras HC
description: An intimate relationship between a man and a woman does not establish consent to sexual acts when the woman’s participation was secured through deception, coercion, intimidation or blackmail, the Madras High Court has held [Suji Vs State].A Bench of Justices N Anand Venkatesh and K Ramakrishnan made the observation while upholding a man's conviction for repeatedly raping and blackmailing a woman using false promises of employment and marriage. The Court affirmed the man's penalty of imprisonment
